search_window.anchor: The preceding Gaza Source Watch completed approximately 2026-10-10T22:49 PDT, according to its prior run report. This is a bounded supplementary recall watch, including screening for late-discovered reporting; publication/event time is not presumed to fall inside the search window.

ocha_opt.result: Accessible. Index still lists the 2026-10-06 Gaza impact snapshot and 2026-10-05 publication of the 2026-10-02 humanitarian situation report; no new index entry for the window.

who.global_result: Accessible; no new Gaza-specific report or change verified in the observation window.
who.regional_result: Both regional pages returned HTTP 502 Bad Gateway. Detailed primary regional healthcare coverage was unavailable, so the overall run is DEGRADED.

coverage_notes.search_limit_note: OCHA OPT and WHO primary direct page checks conducted first, followed by 12 targeted web searches. Article opens and additional direct WHO page checks were not additional targeted searches.
coverage_notes.source_results_note: Search returns were dominated by older source material. No clearly newly published, independently traceable and nonduplicate qualifying development was established during the observation window.
coverage_notes.conclusion: No new qualifying, nonduplicate Gaza development verified. This negative result is limited by WHO regional endpoint failures and search-index coverage, and does not establish that no relevant events occurred.
